title: Pat01-A
extract_protocol: Human stomach tissues were cut into approximately 1 mm3 pieces and add the 5 ml of dispase in Hanks’ Balanced Salt Solution (STEMCELL Cat# 07913) and 5 mg collagenase type IV (Sigma Cat# C5138) and incubate at 37 °C for 2 h with gently shaking. After the sample was passed through a 100 m cell strainer (Falcon), the suspended cells in PBS (with1 mM EDTA) were centrifuged at 720 g for 5 min. To remove RBC in the sample, cell pellets were re-suspended PBS (with1 mM EDTA) and centrifuged through a discontinuous 50% Percoll® (Sigma Cat# P4937) gradient, at 470 g for 20 min, with minimum acceleration and no deceleration. The sample between layers PBS and 50% Percoll® was collected re-suspended in PBS for scRNA-seq. | 10x signle cell 3' v2 kit | scRNA-seq
data_processing: Single-cell RNA sequencing data were quantified using the 10X software package cellranger to map sequencing data to version 1.2.0 of the build of the hg19 reference genome supplied by 10X Genomics | Gene count matrix was generated from unique molecular identifiers (UMIs) that produced from cellranger count. | We filtered out cells that if any cells meet one of the following thresholds: 1) cells that lower variation than average variation with all genes; 2) cells that have zero UMI count 90% of all genes; 3) cells that greater than 10% expression originating from mitochondrial or hemoglobin genes; 4) cells that have UMIs lower than 100 or larger than 20000. | Genome_build: Hg19 | Supplementary_files_format_and_content: tab-delimited text files include UMI count values for each Sample
